title: Cover alternate launcher locator forms and dirty-source notice retention
outcome: Native launcher delta tests discriminate STARTED/results locator forms, overlong prefixed lines, and retention of the original correlated advice after source changes.
acceptance: Tests cover RUN, STARTED and results: .../results.json forms, including split input where relevant.
An overlong locator-prefixed line reaches its specific invalidation branch, separately from the existing oversized single-delta control.
The dirty-after-receipt control asserts that honest original registered-launcher advice remains, so an empty line cannot satisfy it.
